text:
Priya (PM): quick sync — Customer Helios needs onramp acceptance dates nailed down. I sketched a proposed cadence: staging smoke 2026-05-05, canary 2026-05-12, GA 2026-05-26. Need sign-off on infra slots, runtime compat, and security gating.
Liam (Eng Lead): sounds fine if runtime can hit perf targets. what's the acceptance perf metric we gate on?
Jun (Runtime): perf targets = p95 latency < 120ms for 1k qps baseline during canary. Also need quantized model variant validated by 04/28.
Marta (Infra): infra can reserve two reserved GPU pools for canary week but we need commit by EOD Fri (04/18) to avoid reslot churn.
Omar (Security): quick note — we require pen-test signoff OR a scoped risk acceptance for ephemeral staging. Can we get a short checklist?
Priya (PM): here's a minimal acceptance checklist I propose:
```
- Staging smoke run (end-to-end)
- Perf: p95 < 120ms at 1k qps
- Functional: routing + fallback exercised
- Observability: traces + token-level cost visible
- Security: threat model reviewed + either pen-test or RA signed
- Rollback plan + capacity fallback verified
```
Liam (Eng Lead): fine. Jun can you run a dry perf run against staging variant by 04/20? if green we'll lock dates.
Jun (Runtime): can do, but need infra prewarm window. Marta — can you guarantee prewarm by 04/19?
Marta (Infra): yes, prewarm slot from 04/19-04/22. I'll add a reserved pool and enable autoscale limits for canary burst.
Riley (SRE): we'll wire in the synthetic canary monitors and smoke alerting on 04/21. Also want the fallback policy tested (model variant -> smaller model -> queued responses).
Omar (Security): for pen-test, if schedule slips, we'll accept a Risk Acceptance (RA) doc signed by security and product for canary only, but GA must have a pen-test report.
Priya (PM): good constraint — canary RA OK, GA needs pen-test. I'll draft RA template and ping you, @Omar.
Liam (Eng Lead): one more thing — routing policies. Prod team wants regional routing off for canary to simplify data flows. Jun, will runtime accept single-region for canary?
Jun (Runtime): yes, runtime can pin to us-west-2 for canary. That reduces cross-region KV costs.
Marta (Infra): note that single-region increases blast radius; we should confirm evacuation playbook. I'll post the evacuation steps in ops-runbook channel.
Priya (PM): action list I captured:
- Jun: perf dry run by 04/20 -> post results here
- Marta: reserve prewarm pool 04/19 and post autoscale config by 04/18
- Riley: create canary monitors + smoke alerts by 04/21
- Omar: RA template by 04/17; pen-test schedule for GA
- Priya: lock customer acceptance dates by 04/18 after infra + runtime thumbs-up
Liam (Eng Lead): dependency note: if perf fails, we may need extra infra or rollback to smaller model which impacts cost. Let's include cost delta estimate in the postmortem.
Priya (PM): agreed — include cost delta in canary readout.
DevDeployBot: deploy request created: canary/helios/2026-05-12 -> status: queued (ref: DPL-8892)
Jun (Runtime): saw the deploy ticket. I'll attach the model validation logs when done.
Marta (Infra): added autoscale config: `min_replicas=2, max_replicas=8, prewarm_replicas=4` to the ticket.
Omar (Security): RA template posted: https://internal.redwood/ra/helios-canary. PM + eng to add notes, then I'll review.
Priya (PM): ok locking dates: staging smoke 2026-05-05, canary 2026-05-12, GA 2026-05-26 pending perf sign-off. If any blocker surfaces we'll do a one-week slip.
Liam (Eng Lead): noted. If Jun's run fails we should convene an emergency triage call — suggest 15-min slot the day after failures.
Riley (SRE): I'll add a calendar slot auto-invite to the canary channel for triage windows.
Priya (PM): thanks everyone. tagging summary: @Liam @Jun @Marta @Omar @Riley — please update your action items in the ticket and drop a one-line status here when done. :thumbsup:
Liam (Eng Lead): will do.
Jun (Runtime): perf run scheduled.
Marta (Infra): prewarm confirmed.
Omar (Security): RA draft ready for review.
Riley (SRE): monitors created and smoke alerting wired.
Priya (PM): closing the loop — I'll update the customer with the tentative GA and the gating criteria after EOD 04/18.
